parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.778 is high, the two methods — `PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.multipleStopCallsAreIdempotent` (line 132) and `StopBehaviorTests.playAfterStopWorks` (line 234) — are deliberately distinct test scenarios: one asserts idempotency of repeated stop calls, the other asserts that playback resumes correctly after a stop. Merging or deduplicating them would obscure the intent of each behavioral assertion and risk masking regressions. Test fixtures are load-bearing by policy and dominate any action signal.
